operational_conflict_definition: Two preserved Completed Experiences conflict when, under the same frozen current relation and possibility set, their provenance-linked records support different feasible action identities.
support_rule: Production must preserve both CEs, produce exactly one contextual YES and one provenance-preserved NO, correctly realize the context-linked action in all cases, and the registered order/relation/latest-only controls must diverge on their prespecified relevant subsets.
invalidation_rules: undeclared mutation of stored order/relation provenance
